claims: Publix is closed on Sunday, April 5, 2026, for Easter Sunday.
All Publix store locations are closed in observance of Easter Sunday.
All Publix pharmacies are closed in observance of Easter Sunday.
Publix normal business hours will resume on Monday, April 6.
Publix pharmacies are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Publix Liquor Stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
